professional_summary: Data Analyst and Master’s Graduate with 3+ years of experience transforming complex datasets into actionable business insights. Expert in the full data lifecycle,from ETL and Data Cleaning to Statistical Analysis and Visualization. Proficient in SQL, Python, Tableau, and Power BI. Proven track record of identifying operational inefficiencies and building automated reporting solutions that drive revenue growth and cost savings. Strong communicator skilled in presenting data stories to non-technical stakeholders.

responsibilities: Designed and deployed interactive dashboards to track user engagement KPIs, providing leadership with real-time visibility into program performance.
Architected automated ETL pipelines using Python AND SQL to ingest raw data from disparate sources, cleaning and transforming it for downstream analytics.
Analyzed user behavior trends to identify drop-off points, presenting data-driven recommendations that improved user retention by 40%.
Established data quality standards and validation protocols, ensuring 99.9% accuracy in beneficiary reporting and compliance data.
Collaborated with non-technical stakeholders to define reporting requirements, translating business questions into complex SQL queries and actionable visualizations.
Automated the generation of daily financial reports using Excel Macros (VBA) and SQL, reducing manual data entry time by 35%.
Performed rigorous data cleansing and normalization on legacy financial records, migrating data to a modern relational database environment.
Analyzed loan processing workflows to identify bottlenecks, utilizing data evidence to propose process improvements that increased throughput.
Managed and optimized SQL queries for large-scale transaction datasets, ensuring efficient data retrieval for ad-hoc business requests.
